name: Sagrada Biblia, versión oficial de la Conferencia Episcopal Española
numbering: Hebrew psalm numbering (the site also shows the Vulgate number in brackets); psalm superscriptions are numbered verses. Ps 9 and 10 share one page on the site and were split at Ps 10:1. Greek Esther additions kept as lettered verses inside Esther (e.g. 1a-1r); in Esther 5 the Greek form of verse 2 (after 5:1a-f) repeats the number 2 and is stored as key "2gr". The site gives no Sirach prologue. Poetry line breaks flattened to spaces.
